edits.old: The one operation sits on base `/api/recovery/valuation/v1` (DP-13) and SCR-13 reaches it through the gateway-bff composite route (DP-19).
edits.new: The one operation sits on base `/api/recovery/valuation/v1` (DP-13) and SCR-13 reaches it through the gateway-bff composite route (DP-19). The data product code, the acceptance write operation, the choice among several appraisals of one asset, the gateway-bff composite route and the wave 3 harness pack are agreed at the wave 3 entry check, and the build runs against the contract fakes until then. The appraisal record has one writer, this service, through its valuation paths on `/api/recovery/valuation/v1`; rwb-asset reads the accepted appraisal through its contract for the floor price and the monthly re-appraisal, and the two asset valuation operations stay with the sibling valuation stories. The `valuation_ext` table is owned by this story in `rwb_valuation`, keyed on `valuation_key`; `stale_flag` and `age_days` are written at receipt and the acceptance fields `accepted`, `accepted_at` and `accepted_by` are left to FEAT-VAL-04. The receipt runs inside the route assessment on `POST /cases/{caseId}/route` with no schedule and no event, and the batch leg is the freshness gate read through the rwb-source-data contract from `v_ace_batch_status`. The contract v1 carries the appraisal elements as one flat group inside the Approval answer; the 404 and 409 messages are message ID slots with no text in this story, and the retention rule of a `valuation_ext` row is recorded as an open P3 item.
